Create a comprehensive Web3 Bouncing Balls game smart contract with the following requirements:
Keep the constructor args as empty 
## Overview
A blockchain-based physics game where players own ball NFTs, compete in arenas, and earn rewards.

## Core Features

### 1. Ball NFT System (ERC-721)
- Each ball is an NFT with dynamic traits:
  * mass (affects collision physics)
  * elasticity (bounce coefficient 0-100)
  * power (shooting force multiplier)
  * color (hex value)
  * level (gained through XP)
  * totalCollisions (lifetime stat)
  * wins/losses record
- Mint new balls with randomized traits (use block.timestamp + msg.sender for pseudo-randomness)
- Upgradeable traits through XP system

### 2. XP & Leveling System (ERC-20 Token)
- Create BallXP token (ERC-20)
- Balls earn XP from:
  * Collisions in matches (1 XP per collision)
  * Winning games (10 XP bonus)
  * Daily play bonuses
- Level up mechanic:
  * Level 1: 0 XP
  * Level N: N * 100 XP required
  * Each level up: choose one trait to boost (+10 to mass, elasticity, or power)

### 3. Game Modes

**PvP Battle Arena:**
- Players stake ETH to enter
- Submit their ball ID
- Arena closes after 2-10 players join
- Winner determined by last ball standing (verified via Merkle proof)
- Prize pool: 70% to winner, 20% to liquidity pool, 10% treasury

**Score Attack:**
- Pay entry fee to play
- Time-limited mode (configurable duration)
- Submit score + replay hash for verification
- Leaderboard with top 10 scores
- Weekly/monthly reward distributions

### 4. Arena Management
- Create/close arenas
- Set entry fees and prize structures
- Track active games
- Emergency pause mechanism
- Anti-cheat: replay hash verification

### 5. Marketplace
- List balls for sale (simple marketplace)
- Buy/sell balls with platform fee (2.5%)
- Price discovery
- Trade history

### 6. Breeding System
- Combine two parent balls to create offspring
- Breeding cost: 0.01 ETH
- Child inherits averaged traits from parents ± 10% random variance
- Breeding cooldown: 7 days per ball
- Max 3 breedings per ball

### 7. Rewards & Economics
- Treasury address for fees
- Liquidity pool for sustainability
- Withdrawal functions for accumulated rewards
- Staking mechanism: stake BallXP tokens for bonus rewards

### 8. Admin Functions
- Set game parameters (entry fees, timeouts, rewards)
- Pause/unpause system
- Update treasury address
- Emergency withdrawal
- Role-based access control

### 9. State Verification
- Store game result hashes
- Merkle tree for collision proofs
- Dispute resolution (48h window)
- Penalize fraud attempts

### 10. Events & Transparency
- Emit events for all major actions:
  * BallMinted, BallUpgraded, BallLevelUp
  * ArenaCreated, GameStarted, GameEnded
  * RewardDistributed, XPEarned
  * BallListed, BallSold, BallBred

## Technical Requirements
- Solidity ^0.8.20
- Gas-optimized (use custom errors, efficient storage)
- Reentrancy protection
- Access control (Owner, Admin, Player roles)
- SafeMath practices
- Comprehensive error handling
- Well-commented code
- Single-file implementation (no external imports except standard interfaces)

## Data Structures
- Ball struct with all traits and metadata
- Arena struct with players, stakes, state
- Game result struct with winner, proof hash
- Marketplace listing struct
- Leaderboard entry struct

## Key Security Features
- Timelock for admin changes
- Maximum limits (e.g., max arena size, max breeding fee)
- Pausable in emergencies
- Protection against front-running
- Verify replay hashes before reward distribution

Please implement this as a production-ready, auditable smart contract with comprehensive inline documentation.
